description: Create a named JSONata transformation on an endpoint: the reshape step that turns a capture into the exact shape one destination expects. Inputs: name, an optional description, expression, and projectId plus endpointId. The expression may reference $body, $headers, $query, and $secrets.NAME by name. A recipe expression that says $install.NAME is a TEMPLATE and there is no runtime $install: materialize each one before creating, either by asking the user for the value or by reading it from the intent as $body.NAME. Returns the transformation id and draftVersionId, and bind_transformation pins that exact version. Read-write token.

endpointId.description: Opaque endpoint id; omit to use the claimed or only endpoint.

projectId.description: Opaque project id; omit to use the claimed or only project.

name: create_transformation
title: Create transformation
